description:
30,000+ dog and cat foods, scored instantly.

Scan the barcode. See what's really in it — before your pet eats it.

PetScans reads every ingredient on the label and tells you what's harmful, what's filler, and what your own pet should be avoiding.

KEY FEATURES:

• Instant Barcode Scanning
Over 30,000 popular dog and cat foods are built into the app. Most scans score the moment the barcode lands — no waiting on a lookup.

• Every Ingredient Explained
Tap any ingredient for a plain-English explanation of what it is, why it's in the food, and what to watch for.

• Photo Ingredient Analysis
Not in the database? Photograph the ingredient label and get the same full analysis.

• Personalized Alerts
Add a profile for each pet with their allergens and sensitivities. PetScans flags anything that conflicts, by name.

• Dual Safety Scoring
Every product gets a general safety score and a suitability score for your specific pet — a food can be fine in general and wrong for your dog.

• Science-Based Analysis
Ingredient safety data sourced from veterinary research, AAFCO guidelines, and toxicology databases.

• Works Offline
The built-in catalog needs no connection at all. Scan in the aisle, basement, or anywhere with no signal.

• Scan History
Keep track of what you've checked, with notes and favorites.

TRUSTED SOURCES:
Our ingredient analysis references AAFCO, FDA pet food regulations, ASPCA Animal Poison Control, Merck Veterinary Manual, and peer-reviewed research.

Note: PetScans provides educational information only and is not a substitute for professional veterinary advice.

Terms of service: https://petscans.app/terms
promotionalText: New: every ingredient now explains itself in plain English, and searching a brand finally puts that brand's foods first. Over 30,000 foods built in.
whatsNew:
Every ingredient now explains itself.

• Tap any ingredient to see what it actually is, why it's in the food, and what to watch for — including the hundreds that used to open an empty sheet.

• Searching by brand works properly now. Type "purina" and you get Purina foods first, instead of whichever product happened to have the shortest name.

• Over 30,000 dog and cat foods are built into the app, up from 20,000.

• Sharper ingredient matching, so more foods score correctly on the first scan.

• A safety warning now looks the same everywhere it appears, so an ingredient can't seem riskier on one screen than another.

Thanks for using PetScans!
